text: Hi, I got a letter from you about my account. My account number is 300101.

name: lookupAccount
result: Account located. The name on file is Maria Gonzalez. If the caller already introduced themselves by this name (first name is enough), do not re-confirm it. If they already spoke their SSN last four, call verifyIdentity with those digits right now; otherwise ask for them once.

text: Thank you. May I have the last four digits of your social security number to verify your identity?
Yes, this is Maria. Maria Gonzalez, and the last four of my social are 7301.

Thank you for verifying your identity, Maria. I see your account has a past due balance of two thousand four hundred eighty nine dollars and seventy five cents and it has been placed for collection. Are you able to take care of the full balance today?
Oh wow, that's a lot. There's no way I can pay all of that today.
I understand it can be a lot. I can offer you a payment plan spread over three months. Would you like me to check what that monthly amount would be?

name: proposePaymentPlan
result: A 10 month plan is available: 9 monthly payments of $248.98, then a final payment of $248.93, totaling $2,489.75. This is only a proposal; call finalizeAgreement if the caller accepts.

text: I found a payment plan that would work with ten months of payments, about two hundred forty nine dollars per month. Would that be manageable for you?
Yes, ten months works. Let’s do that.

name: finalizeAgreement
result: Agreement recorded: a 10 month plan of $248.98 per month (final payment $248.93), totaling $2,489.75. Recap these exact terms to the caller and tell them a secure payment link will arrive by text and email. Do NOT call end_call in this turn - let the caller respond to the recap first; once they acknowledge, say goodbye and then end the call. Never collect card or bank numbers by voice.

text: We have set up a ten-month payment plan for you with payments of about two hundred forty nine dollars each month, and the total amount remains two thousand four hundred eighty nine dollars and seventy five cents.
